discoveries.title: No authorized original specification is in the repository
discoveries.description: The compatibility matrix and its provenance file describe this repository. They are not an official Rules of Survival dataset.
discoveries.observed_fact: testdata/reference/provenance.json says the compatibility matrix was written from inspection of this repository and is not an official Rules of Survival reference.
discoveries.interpretation: Local implementation and local tests cannot be promoted to original-game compatibility.
discoveries.hypothesis: An authorized specification may exist outside this repository. None is checked in here.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Every feature stays compatibility_status unknown until a new source and a comparison are recorded.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The provenance file labels the matrix, the synthetic player, and the solo scenario as local artifacts.

discoveries.title: Development uses SQLite and production settings expect PostgreSQL
discoveries.description: The README and operations document describe two database targets. The PostgreSQL test was skipped.
discoveries.observed_fact: README.md says development uses SQLite. docker-compose.yml defines PostgreSQL and Redis. RO-008 and RO-028 record that test_postgres_account_roundtrip was skipped because POSTGRES_TEST_URL was unset.
discoveries.interpretation: Schema portability is intended. A skipped PostgreSQL test is not evidence that production PostgreSQL was executed.
discoveries.hypothesis: The same Alembic revision will run on PostgreSQL. That still needs a run with POSTGRES_TEST_URL set.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not claim a PostgreSQL verification. Do not downgrade a database that must be kept.
discoveries.observed_behavior: Startup applies alembic upgrade head to the SQLite file in DATABASE_URL. Compose was not started in RO-010.

discoveries.title: The wire protocol is this server's JSON protocol
discoveries.description: README.md and the architecture decision record describe a project JSON protocol, not an official client protocol.
discoveries.observed_fact: README.md documents version 1 messages auth, lobby.join, player.action, player.input, and state on ws://<host>:8000/api/v1/ws. The architecture record says this is not an official Rules of Survival client protocol.
discoveries.interpretation: Protocol tests prove this server's contract. They do not prove that an original game client can connect.
discoveries.hypothesis: The original client uses a different interface. That interface is not in this repository.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Networking work must keep rejecting unknown versions and must not be described as official-client compatibility.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The first WebSocket message carries the token in the payload. The token is not placed in the URL.

discoveries.title: Migration 93510e8bf194 preserves legacy_players
discoveries.description: The accepted architecture record says the initial revision renames the old players table and does not drop it on upgrade.
discoveries.observed_fact: docs/engineering/ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md states that revision 93510e8bf194 renames players to legacy_players, copies rows, and does not drop the legacy table on upgrade.
discoveries.interpretation: Upgrade is the path for an existing development database. Downgrade is documented for a disposable database.
discoveries.hypothesis: None. The preservation rule is already an accepted decision. RO-009 still has to cite the migration file in a security review.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not rewrite revision 93510e8bf194. Do not delete legacy_players or player-owned rows.
discoveries.observed_behavior: Upgrade keeps the renamed legacy table. Downgrade drops the new tables and is limited to a disposable database.

discoveries.title: Original combat, equipment, and vehicle behavior is unknown
discoveries.description: The matrix records local weapon and movement rules and leaves original behavior unknown. Equipment and vehicles are not implemented.
discoveries.observed_fact: The compatibility matrix marks GP-002, GP-004, and GP-005 as implemented local behavior with compatibility unknown. GP-007 and GP-008 are not implemented. Provenance says the solo scenario expects pistol damage 22 and speed 5 from this server's own files.
discoveries.interpretation: Those numbers are a local contract. They are not an original weapon table.
discoveries.hypothesis: The commercial game has different weapon, vehicle, and equipment behavior. No authorized source for those values is in this repository.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not fill equipment or vehicles with guessed original stats. Tests must cite app/game/items.py and app/game/rules.py when they assert local numbers.
discoveries.observed_behavior: Local health starts at 100 in the matrix notes. Local speed is 5 map units per second. No vehicle simulation is implemented.

discoveries.title: No authorized client build is stored in the repository
discoveries.description: A search of the workspace found no APK, IPA, packet capture, or native library that could be used as a client reference.
discoveries.observed_fact: The workspace contains no .apk, .ipa, .pcap, or .so file. README.md describes a browser client at /play for this server.
discoveries.interpretation: There is a browser play page for this server. There is no checked-in original mobile client to compare against.
discoveries.hypothesis: A user-owned authorized client may be analyzed later under the research rules. That analysis has not started.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not claim the original client can connect. Do not bypass pinning or authentication to obtain a client interface.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The documented client path is the browser page served by this server, using this server's WebSocket messages.

discoveries.title: Locust WebSocket receive timed out
discoveries.description: The short Locust profile failed because the WebSocket client blocked until the run time limit.
discoveries.observed_fact: python -m pytest -q --tb=line on 2026-11-10 finished 1 failed, 64 passed, 1 skipped in 64.35s. tests/performance/test_load.py failed. Locust 2.47.0 logged 4 HTTP requests, 0 HTTP failures, then WebSocketTimeoutException: Connection timed out, and exited 1.
discoveries.interpretation: The HTTP register and login calls in that sample succeeded. The failure is the WebSocket recv in tools/load_generator/locustfile.py waiting until Locust shut down.
discoveries.hypothesis: The server may have sent no further frame after auth, so recv waited for the whole run. That was not separately traced in this audit.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not treat the earlier 4-request sample or this failed run as capacity. Fix or quarantine the test before using it as a regression gate.
discoveries.observed_behavior: Two Locust users registered and logged in. websocket_auth then blocked on recv.

discoveries.title: Public shutdown notice is not a protocol specification
discoveries.description: A public operations announcement was found by web search. It does not describe the client protocol.
discoveries.observed_fact: A web search result for the Steam Community news page of app 788260 included an April 26, 2022 announcement that Rules of Survival—Steam would cease operations on June 27, 2022 at 15:00 and that account and character data would be deleted after shutdown. This session did not open the page in a browser and did not download a client.
discoveries.interpretation: The notice is evidence about a public shutdown date. It is not evidence of authentication, matchmaking, combat, or packet layout.
discoveries.hypothesis: An authorized technical specification may still exist outside this repository. None was retrieved.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Keep every feature compatibility_status unknown. Do not derive endpoints from the shutdown notice.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The search snippet quoted an operations timetable and a data-deletion statement. No packet field was quoted.

discoveries.title: Unread server output blocked the Locust WebSocket client
discoveries.description: The Phase 00 WebSocket timeout was reproduced as a harness problem and cleared without raising the auth timeout.
discoveries.observed_fact: tests/performance/test_load.py previously started uvicorn with stdout=PIPE and did not read the pipe. After writing stdout and stderr to the test log file, the same test passed: 1 passed in 13.69s. The client timeout remains 3 seconds. The full suite then returned 72 passed, 1 skipped.
discoveries.interpretation: The unread pipe could fill and stall the server, so the WebSocket recv reached its timeout after HTTP login had already succeeded.
discoveries.hypothesis: A full pipe was the stall. This session did not capture the pipe buffer filling before the fix. The passing rerun is the evidence that the harness change removed the failure.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Keep the load-test server log on a file. Do not treat a raised timeout as the fix. Do not treat the short sample as player capacity.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The rerun exited 0. The earlier run logged 4 HTTP requests, 0 HTTP failures, then WebSocketTimeoutException.

discoveries.title: Two logins in one second shared a session hash
discoveries.description: A second login in the same second failed the unique token hash constraint until each token carried its own id.
discoveries.observed_fact: tests/integration/test_auth_session.py failed on the second login with sqlite3.IntegrityError UNIQUE constraint failed: account_sessions.token_hash. create_access_token signed only sub, iat, and exp. After adding a unique jti, the focused suite passed 13 tests.
discoveries.interpretation: Identical claims in the same second produced identical tokens and identical SHA-256 hashes.
discoveries.hypothesis: No other unique constraint was involved. The exception text named account_sessions.token_hash.
discoveries.implementation_impact: New tokens include jti. Existing decode still accepts a token that has no jti. This is not a new client protocol.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The second login returned 500 before the change and 200 after it. Logout then rejected only the first token.

discoveries.title: Public search did not produce an authorized client protocol
discoveries.description: A public search returned shutdown notices and one unofficial forum page. Neither is an interface specification.
discoveries.observed_fact: On 2026-11-10 a web search for an official Rules of Survival client network protocol returned the Steam operations announcement, a Wikipedia closure summary, a public Facebook closure post, a news article about the June 27, 2022 shutdown, and a RageZone forum thread about an unofficial local toolkit. No client binary was downloaded. No packet field was copied.
discoveries.interpretation: Shutdown notices confirm an operations date already recorded in DIS-0008. The forum thread is unofficial and is not an authorized reference.
discoveries.hypothesis: An authorized technical specification may exist outside these results. None was retrieved.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Keep every original compatibility row unknown. Do not implement a protocol from the forum thread.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The search snippets described closure dates and an unofficial toolkit. They did not provide an authorized field list that this repository adopted.

discoveries.title: Sibling Android archive is NeoX and is not this service protocol
discoveries.description: The Android game files sit in the sibling client repository, next to this service. They were inspected. They were not copied into this repository.
discoveries.observed_fact: The sibling path Client/Decompiled holds package com.netease.chiji, versionName 1.610637.617289, versionCode 1227927. The launcher is com.netease.neox.Launcher and the game surface is com.netease.neox.Client with libclient.so. On LDPlayer emulator-5554 the surface stayed at the patch-list line 0.00%.
discoveries.interpretation: The archive identifies the engine and build. It does not identify the original network protocol. This service's JSON API remains a separate interface.
discoveries.hypothesis: A later comparison could test whether any native request matches /api/v1. No such match has been observed.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not copy the APK into this repository. Do not treat a NeoX launch as an API test. The independent client package is com.ros.client in the sibling Android_API_Client tree.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The native client process focused com.netease.neox.Client and did not open a lobby.
